scenes.name: last-pool
scenes.prompt: An immense ivory nautilus shell lies half buried in a vast cracked terracotta desert beneath an ink-blue dusk sky. The shell is a sculpted vessel tilted toward us, its open chamber containing the last pool of luminous turquoise water. A small vermilion wooden boat rests on this pool, carrying a single round glowing pearl in its hull. A narrow silver-blue stream escapes the shell toward the lower right and winds far across the dry landscape. On the distant horizon stands one enormous closed ivory flower bud. The shell occupies the left half, the red boat is clearly readable near the middle, and the right half opens into spacious desert and twilight. An exquisite surrealist oil painting with dimensional carved ivory, jewel-colored enamel, deep velvet shadows, warm copper earth, delicate engraved textures and precise luminous highlights. Monumental distinct silhouettes, tactile detail, poetic dream logic and generous negative space.

prompt_schedule.name: the-thin-surface
prompt_schedule.prompt: Glowing ivory lanterns rise beneath a shimmering sea surface. Their translucent shades still resemble jellyfish bells, with fine gold threads and flowing pale ribbons beneath them. One red boat-shaped basket hangs below the largest warm light. Beyond the silver surface there is pale open sky. An exquisite dimensional surrealist oil painting, deep ultramarine and luminous turquoise, pearlescent ivory, warm copper and a small vermilion accent. Tactile carved surfaces, crisp engraved detail, luminous reflected light and deep velvet shadows. Monumental readable silhouettes, generous open space and poetic dream logic.

Fine warm droplets glint in the air, and distant peach-colored clouds begin to appear. Fine golden cords and delicate ribbons connect the boat to the lantern. Broad open sky and soft copper-pink clouds surround it, with the sea far below. A calm turquoise sea forms a thin distant horizon below, and tall soft rose-gold clouds open around a deep ultramarine sky. Air and generous empty space fill the scene. The sky is deep blue above a warm copper horizon, with spacious luminous atmosphere.
